purpose: Prospective H12 single-factor hypothesis shortlist, not numerical evaluation or model promotion

input.task: Prospective H12 experiment choice, not proof of improvement. Four train WAVs, 25ms frames/hop10/range70–400; ACF normalized overlap score and relative RMS gate fit inside each file fold. Accepted path tracking+median3 train mean/std/count AvgMAPE6.178%, LOFO7.279%; manual segment labels available but NO frame F0 truth. Accepted TRAIN errors: V boundary33FN/66, interior51FN/548; UVboundary6FP/59, interior7FP/121; SILboundary1FP/14, interior0/483. Boundary means center within half-window of annotated endpoint. False voiced SIL1 total; recallV .8691. Thus some errors might be mixed-content windows or hard threshold dynamics; which single classical modification is most useful to test AFTER fixed YIN/MPM estimator experiments, while reporting label alignment and avoiding GT-stat-based correction? Require train-only fold fitting and preserve raw labels/metrics. No claimed causal diagnosis from these counts. Include none if evidence insufficient. Select one hypothesis, not hyperparameters or promotion.

options.description: Replace a single ACF voicing threshold by onset/offset hysteresis, retain same features and RMS gate. Fit two score thresholds only on training files/inner LOFO. Could recover adjacent weak V; risk extending voiced runs into UV/SIL.

Keep deployment unchanged; recompute label-overlap fractions and compare center-vs-majority labels only as diagnostic. Establish sensitivity to mixed windows; cannot itself improve recall under unchanged official labels.

Keep ACF threshold unchanged, replace RMS gate by two energy thresholds conditional on previous voiced frame, fold fit; helps energy cutouts but evidence does not show how many boundary errors fail RMS.
Replace raw voiced mask with 3-frame majority vote, same ACF/RMS features/thresholds, no tuning. Removes isolated mask flicker but can remove true short voiced events; affects both boundaries.
Add spectral harmonic evidence to V/UV classifier, train-only calibration; may discriminate mixed/noisy windows but adds a feature and classifier rather than small threshold change.
No single modification is justified yet; stratify FN by which score/RMS condition failed and by temporal neighbors before choosing a deployment experiment.

interpretation: Choice hysteresis .70; independent fit .78. Explicit none option fit .54 is meaningful uncertainty despite tool none .02. No calibration data; use only as a candidate hypothesis. Stratify FN score/RMS/temporal failures before implementation; retain all options and evidence.
